name: Dilthium Ore Trace Deposits
desc: Trace amounts of Dilithium can be found. Although small in amount, Dilithium is not an ore that is passed, even in trace amounts.

name: Dilthium Ore Deposits
desc: Economically viable amounts of Dilithium ore can be detected. Mining and processing Dilithium ore is now viable and produces incoming for a planet with ore available.

name: Dilthium Ore Abundant Deposits
desc: Large amounts of dilithium ore deposits have been detected. The amounts available are lucrative to any business.

name: Terraforming
desc: The process of terraforming a planet has started to progress forward. A thin atmosphere is formed and the world made somewhat habitable. However suits are still required for sustained living on the surface of the planet. Magnetic field of the planet is possible not operation yet, risking irradiated cells alongside an extremely thin breathable atmosphere.

name: Terraformed
desc: A planet has successfully completed the terraforming process. The planet is now habitable without any mechanical aides.

name: Starbase Habitat
desc: This condition only exists for Starbase and Outposts. It's applicable to the population.
